en.html:
A mistake.
The previous exchange—had attacking with what little strength I had left brought me to this?

There was not enough heat to feed the Gattari.
My speed would not rise at all.

With this, withdrawal was impossible!

ja.text:
村正
《御堂、後ろから――》


景明
「止むを得まい。
　村正、反転！」

景明
「交戦を継続――」

en.html:
...Continue the engagement. That was what I had meant to do.
For some reason, I was never given the opportunity.

Never, in all eternity.

　どうしてか、俺にその機会は与えられなかった。

　未来永劫。
